name: Banana Caramel Dessert
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: In a small bowl, toss bananas, vanilla, and melted butter until bananas are well coated.
On a cookie sheet, unroll 2 cinnamon rolls, leaving the two triangles attached to form a square. Place ¼ of the banana mixture in the center of each pair of rolls.
Bake for 11 to 13 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Heat the caramel topping and drizzle over dessert. Serve warm, with ice cream if desired.

culture.text: This dessert appears to be loosely based on or derived from banoffee pie. It combines bananas and caramel sauce with pre-made dough for convenience. The ingredients are simple, the time it takes to prepare is short, and the dessert is simply delicious!
